# United States Department of State

> > Official U.S. government platform for international diplomacy, treaties, cultural property protection, global health security, cyberspace policy, and bilateral agreements.

The U.S. Department of State manages America's foreign relations through treaty negotiations, international agreements, and specialized bureaus covering global health security, cyberspace and digital policy, fiscal transparency, and infrastructure development. The site documents multilateral frameworks (NATO, Four-Power Treaty) and bilateral agreements spanning cultural heritage protection, defense cooperation, and Peace Corps programs.

## Key Topics

- International agreements and treaties
- Cultural property and archaeological material import restrictions
- NATO Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA)
- Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy
- Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy
- Caribbean Basin Security Initiative (CBSI)
- Temporary relocation and transit agreements
- Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)
- Peace Corps programs
- Defense cooperation agreements
- Fiscal transparency and infrastructure finance
- North Atlantic Treaty Organization
- Supplementary agreements
- Fisheries and marine policy

## Bureau Key Topics and Policy Areas

- [Key Topics - Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy](https://www.state.gov/bureau-of-global-health-security-and-diplomacy-key-topics): Key topics for Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy
- [Key Topics - Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy](https://www.state.gov/key-topics-bureau-of-cyberspace-and-digital-policy): Key topics for Bureau of Cyberspace and Digital Policy
- [Infrastructure Transaction Advisory Services](https://www.state.gov/development-finance/taf): Infrastructure transaction advisory services (TAF) program
- [Fiscal Transparency Innovation Fund](https://www.state.gov/fiscal-transparency-innovation-fund): Fiscal Transparency Innovation Fund program details

## Cultural Property and Archaeological Import Restrictions

- [Poland (10-803) - Agreement on the Protection of Certain Cultural Properties](https://www.state.gov/10-803): Cultural property protection agreement with Poland (10-803)
- [Chile (20-930) - Archaeological Material Import Restrictions MOU](https://www.state.gov/chile-20-930): Chile archaeological import restrictions MOU (20-930)
- [Honduras (14-307) - Pre-Columbian Archaeological Import Restrictions](https://www.state.gov/14-307): Honduras Pre-Columbian archaeological import restrictions (14-307)
- [Pakistan (24-130) - Archaeological and Ethnological Materials Import Restrictions](https://www.state.gov/pakistan-24-130): Pakistan archaeological/ethnological import restrictions (24-130)

## NATO and Multilateral Defense Agreements

- [Agreement Between the Parties to the North Atlantic Treaty Regarding the Status of Their Forces (1951)](https://www.state.gov/north-atlantic-treaty-status-of-their-forces): 1951 NATO Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA)
- [NATO Agreement on the Communication of Technical Information for Defense Purposes (1970)](https://www.state.gov/nato-technical-information-for-defense-purposes): 1970 NATO technical information defense agreement
- [NATO SOFA Germany - Implementation of Article 45 (1993)](https://www.state.gov/nato-sofa-germany-agreement-to-implement-paragraph-1-of-article-45): 1993 NATO SOFA Germany supplementary implementation agreement

## Bilateral Defense and Security Agreements

- [Bahamas (13-611) - Caribbean Basin Security Initiative Defense Agreement](https://www.state.gov/13-611): Bahamas defense agreement under CBSI (13-611)
- [Guyana (13-130) - Caribbean Basin Security Initiative Defense Agreement](https://www.state.gov/13-130): Guyana defense agreement under CBSI (13-130)
- [Saudi Arabia (19-912) - Technical Cooperation Agreement Amendment](https://www.state.gov/saudi-arabia-19-912): Saudi Arabia technical cooperation agreement amendment (19-912)

## Temporary Relocation and Transit Agreements

- [Oman (21-902) - Temporary Relocation Transit Agreement](https://www.state.gov/oman-21-902): Temporary relocation transit agreement with Oman (21-902)
- [Kosovo (21-825) - Temporary Relocation Transit Agreement](https://www.state.gov/kosovo-21-825): Kosovo temporary relocation transit agreement (21-825)
